glossary.definition: (1) "Accommodated party" means the party to an instrument for the benefit of which the instrument is issued for value.
glossary.source_title: Section 1303.59 - Instruments signed for accommodation - UCC 3-419.

glossary.definition: (2) "Accommodation party" means a party to an instrument other than the accommodated party.
glossary.source_title: Section 1303.59 - Instruments signed for accommodation - UCC 3-419.
